name: Ashura
source: The leader of the evil organization Ragnarokkr, she fights the Jewel Knights while pursuing her orders from Headquarters to look for a secret treasure. Her secret identity is a waitress who works at a cafe that Ginji frequents. Normally a kind girl, when she transforms into Ashura she becomes haughty and snobbish.
